This module applies the same saved NIST excerpt the last module introduced — no new source was
independently fetched, since the new content here is application (categorizing and selecting
controls for the eQMS), not new citation. The link below was checked at the time this page was
written.

- **[NIST SP 800-37 Rev. 2, "Risk Management Framework for Information Systems and
  Organizations"](https://nvlpubs.nist.gov/nistpubs/SpecialPublications/NIST.SP.800-37r2.pdf)**
  (PDF, final, December 2018) — the document behind both quotes in this lesson (Categorize's
  purpose statement and Select's one-line action), via the same saved excerpt in `sources/nist/`
  used last module. Curl-checked directly from this session: returns HTTP 200.

- **[Risk management frameworks side by side](../risk-frameworks-side-by-side/index.qmd)** — this
  course's first module: the comparison that justified borrowing RMF's structure for the eQMS in
  the first place, and where the Categorize and Select steps were first named (without being
  applied). Read it for the full three-framework comparison this module assumes.

- **NIST SP 800-53** — the separate publication that actually defines control families and
  numbered controls. Not independently fetched or quoted anywhere in this curriculum; mentioned
  here only so you know where the real catalog lives if Lakeshore ever needs more than the family
  names this module uses.
